highRiskTriageRule: usageRule in {safe_for_external_claims, requires_actor_gate, claim_candidate_review} OR riskFlags contains type_b_actor_gate OR claimCandidateCount > 0

automatedRounds.method: stratified sample per research/_plans/kalibreringsplan-utvalg-2026-08-20.md §3; seeded draw (seed 20260823) archived in the private run root as calibration-sample-extract-2026-08-23.json
automatedRounds.planVerdict: critical rate below the plan §5 2 % band in every adjudicated stratum: calibrated with measured rate; no class frozen
caveats: The `tiny` stratum has no adjudicated source in this round; its error profile is unmeasured.
`mixed` rests on 2 sources / 107 claims, so its interval is wide.
Sources with more than 6 jobs were excluded from the sampling frame for cost control, so the long-document profile is under-represented.
`table_inventory` sources were excluded by owner decision; the rate does not describe them.
`pre_sample` rows are the 2026-08-23 queue-order sources adjudicated before the sampling frame was drawn; they are reported separately because they were not randomly selected.
Analyzer and validator are the same model family, so validatorSeparation is same_model: this is drift and grounding control, not independent verification.

rateBasis: Sample calibration 2026-08-23: 717 claims adjudicated across 38 sources under prompt/validation version 1.0.23. Critical (F1+F2) 0.14 % [0.02 %, 0.79 %]; quality (F3-F5) 4.04 % [2.83 %, 5.75 %]. This is an automated-only measurement of pipeline drift and grounding, not human or external verification.
